anchors.quote: چرا دانشگاه بالاه معمولاً وقتی این کارو می‌کنن که تازه فارغ تحصیل شده بشن و سقای کار نداشته باشن

claim_en: For the machine learning CV (CV#24), the recruiter asks why education is at the top: usually that is done by fresh graduates without work experience.
quote_en: Why is the university at the top? Usually people do this when they have just graduated and have no work experience.

anchors.quote: خب گروپ نکرده توصیه می‌کنم گروپ کنیم

claim_en: For the machine learning CV (CV#24), the recruiter recommends grouping the listed skills.
quote_en: Well, they have not grouped them; I recommend we group them.

anchors.quote: دقیقاً اگه ماشین لرنینگه من هیچ چیزی ندیدم حداقل انتصار داشتم بره یه چار تا پروژه زده باشی اونا بیا توضیح بده
هیچ چیزشون به اون به اون صورت واسه من جذاب نبود که بخوام دعوتش کنم دعوت نمیشه

claim_en: The recruiter rejects the early-career machine learning CV (CV#24) because it shows no machine learning projects; they expected at least a few projects, explained.
quote_en: Exactly, if it is machine learning, I saw nothing; at least I expected them to have done some four projects and explain them. / None of them was attractive enough for me to want to invite them; not invited.

anchors.quote: این آدم میره آدمای خوب و تاپو پیدا می‌کنه به عنوان یه لیست رزوماشونو می‌گیره
میرن با اون شرکت نگوشییت می‌کنن یا مذاکره می‌کنن میگن من یه آدم خوب دارم
میان به شما یه درصدی پول می‌گیرن بابت اون کار و میان معرفی می‌کنن رزومه شما رو

claim_en: Independent and freelance recruiters find strong candidates, keep their CVs on a list, and when a company opens a role they pitch a candidate to it and introduce the CV for a percentage fee.
quote_en: This person goes and finds the good, top people and takes their CVs as a list. / They go and negotiate with that company and say: I have a good person. / They take a percentage as payment for that work and introduce your CV.

anchors.quote: مصاحبه اولی که می‌گیری با این آدمه مصاحبه با خود شرکته نیست مصاحبه با اون ریکروتر است

claim_en: With an independent recruiter, the candidate's first interview is with that recruiter, not with the company.
quote_en: The first interview you get is with this person; the interview is not with the company itself, it is with that recruiter.

anchors.quote: اینا میرن برای تو کار پیدا می‌کنن
پس خیلی خوبه که این مدل ریکروترا رو باهاشون کانکشن بزنید
با اینجور آدما تو لینکدین کانکت بشید
حتماً ظرفیت ریکروترها رو در نظر بگیرین باهاشونین کانکشین

claim_en: Connect on LinkedIn with independent and agency recruiters and use them as a channel, because they go and find jobs for the candidate.
quote_en: They go and find work for you. / So it is very good to connect with this kind of recruiter. / Connect with such people on LinkedIn. / Definitely consider what recruiters can do; connect with them.

anchors.quote: که ما با یه آژانس ریکروتری قرارداد داشتیم اینا قرار بود هفته‌ای مثلاً د تا سی وی برامون می‌فرستادن
باعث میشد که ما وقتمونو زیاد نذاریم واسه بررسی ده‌ها و صدها رزومه

claim_en: At a former employer of the recruiter, a contracted recruitment agency sent a few high-quality CVs a week, so the team did not spend time reviewing tens or hundreds of CVs.
quote_en: We had a contract with a recruitment agency; they were to send us, say, ten CVs a week. / That meant we did not spend much time reviewing tens and hundreds of CVs.
notes: 'د تا' is likely 'ده تا' (ten); claim_en avoids the number.
